title: 'When you play me ... you may ready something besides me that's exhausted' resolves as a no-op
expected: parseAbilities on Jayce's rulesText (invoked at packages/riftbound-cards/src/data/enrich-cards.ts:30) produces a triggered ability (event play-self-or-play-gear, optional:true) whose effect is {type:'raw', text:"ready something besides me that's exhausted."} — the effect clause is unparsed (fallback at packages/riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/triggers.ts:230). In the engine, executeEffect (packages/riftbound-engine/src/abilities/effect-executor.ts:172-184) does EFFECT_HANDLERS[effect.type]; there is no 'raw' handler anywhere under abilities/, so it hits the '// default: no-op' branch at line 183. Hence opt-in resolves with no target prompt and nothing is readied. No TS card override exists for ven-068a-166 (only ven.json, parseSuccess:false, abilities:[]).
observed: Trigger went on chain with effect {type:'raw', text:'ready something besides me that's exhausted.'}; opt-in pendingChoice appeared and was accepted, but no target prompt followed and Pouty Poro stayed exhausted=true. Effect is unparsed/unimplemented (ven.json parseSuccess:false, abilities:[])
